doc.title: Dan Morgenstern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 9, 2013

title: Grammy-winning liner notes
summary: He credits the musicians; his Grammys are for notes on Tatum, Armstrong, Waller, Garner and Clifford Brown.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: No kidding. And of the Grammys you received, would you have said yes, that was some of my best work?

Well, as I usually would say when I got these Grammys, it’s no great — it’s due to the great musicians that I was able to write about and the great music that I was able to write about. My Grammys are notes for — I think for Art Tatum, for Louis Armstrong, for Fats Waller, for Erroll Garner, for Clifford Brown. Hey. You know.
